title: UG-002 — How to create a quiz survey
intent: Describe how a survey manager creates a new quiz survey.
short_answer: Create a new survey and select the Quiz type. After entering the required survey information and clicking Create, EUSurvey opens the survey editor so that quiz questions can be added.
important_conditions: Quiz surveys are created as a separate survey type.
Standard survey features such as translations, guest lists and security settings can still be used later.
